newsitem.title: USA: Gregg ends offer to buy Sun Television.
newsitem.headline: Gregg ends offer to buy Sun Television.

text.p: Sun Television and Appliances Inc said Gregg Appliances Inc was terminating its previously announced offer to acquire the company, after a review of Sun's preliminary third quarter operating results.
On December 11, Sun Television said it would be acquired through a $5 per share cash merger by Indiana-based appliance and electronic retailer Gregg Appliances Inc.

But Sun said it received notification that Greg was ending the offer. "Gregg management indicated the decision resulted from its review of Sun's preliminary results of operations for the third quarter ended November 30, 1996," Sun said.
Sun Television said it expected to report a fiscal 1997 third quarter net loss of between about $3.9 million and $4.2 million, or between $0.22 and $0.24 per share.
Results were due the week of December 29.
The First Call mean estimate for the third quarter was a loss of $0.04 per share.
Sun Television is a specialty retailer of consumer electronics, home appliance and office products.
